newsitem.title: USA: American Diversified gets $15 mln order.
newsitem.headline: American Diversified gets $15 mln order.

text.p: American Diversified Group Inc said Thursday it has received $15 million in purchase orders from Emerging Trends Linkages Corp.
The purchase orders are from West Africa for pharmaceuticals, vitamins, human serum albumin and test kits. The orders are for delivery through December 31, 1997.

American Diversified previously received an order for those products from Emerging Trends for a minimum of $700,000 and a maximum of $1.2 million. The company is outsourcing the products from third-party manufacturers for shipment beginning December 1996.
